notes.title: V. 3.81, "Rampage Update"
notes.notes:
[b]Added the Rampage Vinyl[/b]

A new 12-track compilation album is out featuring tracks from LunaNightZ, Bucket Of Chicken, and myself. Dubbed "Rampage Compilation" in-game, it has a large focus on heavier rock, industrial, and metal. You can buy it at the LunaNightZ record store and get a cassette as well for portability.

[b]Added several new Arena Mode features[/b]

If you're in Arena Mode, you can play the aforementioned rampage record without spending any backrooms bucks. However, that's far from the only change. There's now a power-up that drops from enemies infrequently. It doubles your damage, but decreases your health slightly for around 30 seconds. It even gets its own theme when active! Secondly, there are new, bigger versions of enemies that can spawn rarely. They're much more difficult to take down, as they have 3-4x the amount of health of the normal ones.

[b]Added Firesalt Pistol[/b]

This 5-shot fire-shooting pistol is currently only available in arena mode but will be made available to the rest of the backrooms sometime soon. Suggested by @FrankC on our discord

[b]Added MEG Faction Status[/b]

Guards now adorn the MEG bases alpha and omega, and if you do something bad (shooting inside the base) the MEG won't like you very much. Good luck trying to walk into a MEG base after that, you'll get instantly recognized. In addition, new MEG soldiers will attempt to hunt you down if you're still inside the base when the alarm is going off. To equalize this, I made detection of threats to the MEG much more lenient. A system to buy another identity will be added, allowing you to re-enter the MEG bases if you'd like to stay on the straight and narrow.

[b]Added level 75 preview[/b]

Level 75 is a new cave level that has rising and falling liquid metal in the pits. This metal is extremely difficult to swim through and will suffocate you if your head goes under, so watch out! Only run when the "tide" is down, and keep a close eye on which direction it's headed. The reason this is a preview is that there's still relatively little to do in the level, and the collision for some of the rocks is beyond horrendous. You can try to find the exit though, if you see orange rocks, you know you're on the right track.

[b]Improved level 188 preview[/b]

Many new walls and text actors have been replaced. Lights have been added to the bottom-most halls, and many cracks into the void have been sealed (with a quantum trowel of seal flex). The ambience has also been worked on. It's a slow process but this version

[b]You can now dispense water from the warm or cool side[/b]

Since water coolers were first added, you have only been able to dispense water from the cold side. Now, if you want warm water, you can have it. Why? All in the name of "immersion" I guess!

Did some subtle lighting changes to level 40
Whitened the whiteout
Added fouling to the ceiling tiles
Reinforced level 4 floor
Keypad now shows previous numbers
Replaced level 4 fire extinguisher model[/b]

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Level 4 complete revamp[/b]

The same achievements and easter eggs from before are still in-game, but in higher graphical fidelity. There are even small details like air conditioners you can turn on and off. There are a few different areas, namely the main area that looks like the pictures, the dark area with smilers and a spooky puzzle, and an 80s themed area which will be built out more soon.

The amount of balloons that actually comes out varies, but it's more than enough to levitate the average entity.

[b]Replaced eating and drinking noises[/b]

This was bound to happen. Let's face it: the drinking noise has long sounded like peeing. Both of the noises have been improved.

A new chunk has been added to level 19, the crawlspace. Rare chunks are now much more common, adding more variance to an already varied level. Deathmoths and passive moths have been added. Deathmoths appear in 1/40 hallways, passive moths appear in 1/20.

Several high-detail meshes have been optimized and cut down for VR usage. Many of the models that we used to create the frontrooms had very high poly counts and needed to be optimized heavily.

notes.title: V. 3.48, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Revamped level 17[/b]

Huge improvements from the ground up have been made to level 17. The level looks much more like a real aircraft carrier now, containing several revamped rooms and many more props. The new version is more uniform in size and quality, has accurate-to-life props, and contains more imperfections.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/888ddc31d5e68acffbfdb972082c054f6869c1d5.png[/img]

[b]Added level -7[/b]

Level 2 makes itself scary by having many entities and a dark atmosphere. Imagine a level being scary because of the exact opposite! When you turn on the light switch in level -7, a singular entity spawns whose idea of fun is disemboweling human wanderers. The worst part is that he is very difficult to defeat, although some explosives will do the trick. Simply turning off the light makes him go away, but then you can't complete the level. There are several keys scattered around the house in which the level takes place. These keys are required to exit, but can only be found when the light is on. See why it's scary now?

[b]Added level 38[/b]

Imagine you smashed levels 0-37 together and then made it playable. This is pretty much level 38. There are traits of many different levels all in a shell that looks like level 0.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/e6561df5089cabc4fcf8da8ba7d8514d6802799f.png[/img]

Here you can see many of these traits. Level 0 wallpaper and carpet, level 23 trees, level 22 rubble, level 20 machines, level 27 waterfall, poolrooms tiles, level 8 stalagmites, level 18 toys, and level 2 pipes.

[b]Added level 70[/b]

YES, three levels in one week. Level 70 is a self storage facility at dark, which has openable containers. You can often find random loot in the containers, but guns are very rare.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/b175707beb04b77715e37ba388ca92c6d8271edd.png[/img]

[b]Added metal barricade[/b]

A new thing that can be built with the building blueprint. Allows you to repel entities, but you can still jump over it to get out.

[b]Added hazmat skin-stealers[/b]

A skin-stealer in a hazmat suit, what did you expect? These can be found on the new level 70, but can also be found in levels 15 and 2.

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Added many new options for doors[/b]

Now, you can pick between several different types of door pictures that go on the front of no-clip-a-matics. There are five options now instead of two. The options are Normal, like it starts out; Destroy, which removes the picture entirely; Glitch, which replaces the picture with a z-fighting texture; Glitch B, which replaces the picture with a flipbook animated wallpaper material; and Interior, which replaces the picture with an industrial-looking interior cubemap.

[b]Added back Killed By[/b]

Remember when you were able to see what killed you? Well, now you can again! It is located on the last row of your watch.

[b]Fixed the dying in slomo bug[/b]

Simple fix, this ensures that if you die while having the slomo setting on, you will not be trapped in slomo.

[b]Made level !-! Infinite[/b]

Now, on the exit chunk of !-! there is a new hallway behind the door that allows you to keep running level !-!.

[b]Added more goofy ahh mode sounds[/b]

Some new sounds for the airhorn and for getting dropped out of the map have been added.

[b]Fixed !-! Traps[/b]

The traps in level !-! now have the newer trap model, are facing inwards, have a base piece, and have a much better hitbox than before.

[b]Added better partygoer balloon animations[/b]

The balloon now follows the X and Y position of the hand directly, instead of it floating without attachment. This makes it all look much more natural.

[b]Made many changes to level -8[/b]

The minecart has been temporarily disabled until we find a better solution for it. The Tall Shadow has also been nerfed slightly.

[b]Adjusted M1 Garand Hand Hold[/b]

A user was having trouble aiming the M1 Garand, so hopefully this change will help fix that.

[b]Added Building Blueprint Beta[/b]

THIS IS A VERY EXPERIMENTAL FEATURE! A new item, the building blueprint, has been added to Moe's Building Supplies in level 1. It allows you to build custom structures and objects in the backrooms which you can return to at will. Currently, you can build 6 different pieces: Wooden walls, wooden walls with windows, wooden walls with doorframes, wall torches, crafting tables, and upgrade benches.

Any structures you make will (hopefully) save automatically. I have run into a couple of saving issues while testing though, and those will be ironed out in the coming weeks. The UI will also be overhauled and more features will be added like different types of walls, a buildable vault, and a rack to save items on.

The building blueprint costs 15,000 Backrooms Bucks and can be bought at level 1's Moe's Building Supplies.

[b]Hard Mode Door Adjustments[/b]

The other thing we have this week (a lot of effort went into the blueprint) is some adjustments to doors in hard mode. Doors in hard mode will now be stripped of their text, leaving some confusion as to where they go. However, if you hear a faint siren beware, as there is now a 1/150 chance for them to lead to level RUN.

[b]Added sounds and new UI to the building blueprint[/b]

New sounds for creating/destroying things have been added. In addition, the buttons now have rounded corners like the crafting UI. Several small things have been fixed as well.

[b]Added increments to the auto regen health setting[/b]

The regeneration speed can now be set to slow, medium and fast. It still only applies once health is lower than half.

[b]Changed several shell ejection and recoil values[/b]

The MP7 and ASVAL now have some backwards recoil, the PPSH doesn't eject shells with nearly the velocity, and the AK-47 has an increased fire rate.

[b]Screwdriver is now always in your backpack[/b]

There is now a slot on the side of the backpack that always will contain a screwdriver for easy access. Funny known bug, you will now always spawn with a screwdriver right below you.

[b]Added several new areas to level 0[/b]

Some new halls and spooky events have been added. These new areas provide some refuge from entities as well, and just some more halls to get lost in.

[b]Added fireworks to the bazooka[/b]

Happy 4th to those in the US! The partygoer confetti rounds now provide the bazooka with a firework-styled projectile instead of the normal confetti projectile.

[b]Removed the usage for forks[/b]

Now you can stuff your entire face into a tub of food like a pig! This goes for Royal Rations, Hound Meat Stew, and Scraps.

[b]Almond water now restores less hunger[/b]

This was a balancing change requested because...almond water is a drink. The stats for sanity and health have not been changed though.

[b]Added metal walls to the building blueprint[/b]

There is a new wall type on the building blueprint: metal walls. These can be built with four I-Beams, which equates to 12 workable metal. For reference, the wooden walls require 14 wood logs. More coming soon.

[b]Gotten rid of an infinite money glitch with chips[/b]

Now, you cannot put casino chips in the vault! I have no idea why they were able to be put in there in the first place, but woot.

[b]Optimized the frontrooms apartment a bit[/b]

Many meshes in the frontrooms apartment hadn't gotten proper LODs, now they have them!

[b]Adjusted right stick deadzone[/b]

The right stick's crouch deadzone is now set to be a much higher value than before.

Now for some rapid-fire changes:

[b]Added goofy ahh music to level 31[/b]
[b]Added an obsidian floor to the top of level 28[/b]
[b]Added a smoother animation to the m79[/b]
[b]Added an ambidextrous energy marker to the laser gun
Removed many guns from level 13
Reduced the cost of the building blueprint
Added a bulk wood buyer to Moe's Building Supplies [/b]

notes.title: V. 3.43, MAIN BRANCH UPDATE
notes.notes:
[h1]This update is back on the main branch! If you are on the beta branch, you will also be updated to this version automatically.[/h1]

Here are some things that are new this week:

[b]Revamped the majority of th3 sh4dy gr3y[/b]

Level0Zero, Level1One, and Level3Three have all gotten several enhancements such as better lighting, more props, shadows, and new landscapes. Level3three now has swimmable water.

[b]Made the woodrooms much spookier[/b]

A few new rooms have been added to the woodrooms, and so have some new entities. Specifically, lurkers from level 9. The hounds have been removed.

[b]Added new vault sorting options[/b]

The vault can now be sorted through in two ways. Firstly, there are two alphabetical sorters, one for A-M and one from N-Z. Secondly, there is a new favorites list. Any item can be favorited via a button, and then filtered through with the "filter by favorites" button. You can spawn all of your favorites with the aptly named "spawn favorites" button.

[b]Added a slot radius option[/b]

An option has now been added to increase/decrease hip slot radius by 5 centimeters.

[b]Hunger and sanity now persist across levels[/b]
[b]Made some adjustments to the hub
Fixed a myriad of small bugs
Made several guns unable to be put in the backpack
Added size 4 to the spray painter
Added water physics to Level 63[/b]

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped level 1one[/b]

Level 1one has gotten some significant changes, including the addition of new paintings and props. Walls now align much better. The lighting on the level has also been turned down, giving a more creepy atmosphere. The two AK rifles near spawn have been removed.

[b]Added footsteps to many more surfaces[/b]

Most surfaces will now generate a footstep sound, adding some realism to the act of walking or sprinting.

[b]Added a headbob setting[/b]

Now in settings, you can enable a headbob setting that will kick on whilst sprinting. The camera will move up and down subtly, as if you were actually running.

[b]Fixed the one item in backpack bug[/b]

A huge bug now squashed for eternity! Now you can carry as many chicken pieces as you'd like from one level to another without them turning into little crumbs. Same goes for any other item.

[b]Adjusted the head slot[/b]

Although this is not the case for some items, generally speaking, the hand left behind after eating food will not attempt to grab whatever is in the head slot now.

[b]Improved Malt Mart[/b]

Malt Mart uses kiosks now instead of the items all laying about. The faceling behind the counter is still just as aggressive...

[b]Added more props to level FUN[/b]

The level FUN revamp last week was still a WIP, now it's much closer to completion with the addition of more props like play fences and FUN wall decals.

[b]Revamped level negative 2[/b]

Level negative 2 has gotten a complete overhaul. We started from scratch and built up a huge new level that is over twice as large as the old one (in terms of commonly travelled areas) and is much more detailed. Low-quality models have been swapped out with high-quality ones, and every dirt stain has been placed to make the level feel just a bit less clean and more eerie. You certainly still aren't alone to explore these catacombs by yourself; there are facelings and many hounds attempting to hunt you down. The blue hallways that originally served as a link from the flooded areas to the large dark room now serve as a link between different parts of the level. These hallways have seven different connections to other areas now. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/0b0be074fec983c599dc34bb1b5bc910392b296c.png[/img]

[b]Revamped level FUN[/b]

Level FUN is still a work-in-progress when it comes to furnishing. It will be improved in the coming updates. For now, there are many more play structures than before, even featuring a multi-level playplace that is fully explorable (picture below). There will be an even larger one in the future, that's for sure. The new version is a static level, compared to the procedurally generated one that was there. However, there is still a door to get to the procedurally generated section.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/3b8e36162ff47c73bfeed2701c230d8f35e21104.png[/img]

[b]Revamped the Terror Hotel Casino[/b]

The casino is now crowded with slots machines everywhere you look. It is now a maze of blinding lights and mystifying sounds to get from one game to the next, compounded by the multiple ambient voices emanating from the games. The casino now feels much more "real", as it is now densely packed with games. Instead of using kiosks to buy chips, The Beast of Level 5 will hand them to you. There are two new games, video poker and the backrooms lottery, which both have their own section on this changelog.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/9983c9858cf3f4dcf281f8e1914d67b2ba3493ae.png[/img]

[b]Added video poker[/b]

An exciting game, video poker is very similar to a "9/6 Jacks or Better" machine from the frontrooms. You put a token in and hit draw to be dealt a hand. Then, you choose the cards you would like to hold and press draw again. The cards you have not held will be re-rolled, and that will be your final hand. You will be dealt chips based on what that hand is. The only difference between in-game video poker and frontrooms video poker is that the pay tables are slightly different. You get paid a bit more in-game for worse hands than you would in real life.

[b]Added backrooms lottery[/b]

A fun vending machine now sits in the corner of the Terror Hotel Casino. You can purchase a ticket for one chip, and then scratch it off. Your odds are 225:1 at winning, but if you do win, you will receive $15000.

[b]Added a way to spawn steel beams for trap building[/b]

Building traps for entities has never been easier! All you have to do is press the button on the new UI and the metal will spawn for building. The metal is taken out of the same inventory used for crafting.

[b]Added a new delete gun persistence setting[/b]

In V. 3.39, we removed the ability to take the delete gun between levels. This change is now toggleable via a setting.

[b]Slightly decreased general payout[/b]

As most people who were grinding (on our discord at least) have now made their money, it seems as though it is the best time to adjust payouts for certain jobs. Most everything, including the level 20 crate minigame, the level 24 plastic factory minigame, the bartending and room service minigames on level 13, the casino in level 5, and the bounties on level 1 have all been adjusted. Some things that haven't been adjusted are the MEG missions, entity trading cards, and arcade games. All of these ways to make money have been normalized so that one is not exactly better than the others. Some more tweaking is most likely necessary though.

[b]Added a new stats screen to the frontrooms[/b]

Scopes now have proper eye relief and depth simulation instead of being completely flat. The scope also has an improved reticle and the display is a bit darker.

Enabling goofy ahh mode (introduced on April Fools) will now cause all footsteps to turn into "dink dink dink" noises. Voiced by none other than me.

For 15 pieces of plastic, you can now craft a squirt gun at any crafting table. You cannot craft the UMK or Big Squirt yet, but you can craft the Lil Squirt.

Checkpoints are now represented by chairs instead of awkward concrete pillars. A noise now plays when you save via the checkpoint as well.

[b]Added tooltips[/b]

Around 39 items now have proper tooltips telling you either what the object is or how to operate it. Tooltips stay on the screen for 5 seconds after use, and then they do not appear again on that item. More tooltips for guns coming soon.

[h1][b]Now, if you were on the main branch you'll get a ton of other stuff from past beta updates:[/b][/h1]

[b]Revamped level 18[/b]

A new level 18 is now here! This level revamp may just be the largest one that we've attempted yet. This is only its second week in the game, the first being as a preview. There are still many bugs, but we feel that it is in a good enough state to ship out as a Beta.

There are two maps to level 18, the spawn map and the main map. First, I will talk about the spawn map.

The spawn map is a maze of rooms, separated into three main halls. You start in a large colorful playroom with tons of oversized toys like a xylophone and rocking horse. You can even walk on the xylophone and play it! The first hallway is cloud-themed. There are many oversized dinosaur toys inside of it, among other props. The second hallway is a dark blue kindergarten classroom. There are small rock climbing walls near the edges, and a few toys in the classroom itself. In the back halls of the classroom is a strange area with uncanny AI paintings on the walls. This leads to the main map. The third hallway is a very dark children's bedroom with many blankets and beds. There are also several desks which contain drawings with some of our playtesters' names on them. This room also leads to the main map.

The main map is a vast expanse of childlike areas. It is separated into 6 main areas: the neighborhood, the school, the playground, the tubes, the clouds, and the church. First, the neighborhood contains all sorts of suburban houses similar to those of level 9. These houses contain many bits of trash and surreal scenes like lightbulbs baking on a stovetop. It is heavily implied that kids have lived in these houses at one point or another. Second, the school is an eight-part complex of rooms. The school itself is separated into two parts, the daycare and the high school. The daycare is filled with rooms like a stuffed animal room, a room full of boxes, a locker maze, and more. The high school is filled with rooms like classrooms, cafeterias, and libraries. Third, the playground is a smaller area with a large amount of modern playground equipment. There is also a tennis enclosure there, which you can walk into. Fourth, the tubes is the section that is the most similar to the original level 18. There is a lot of playground equipment here as well, however it is all run-down Russian playground equipment instead of modern American equipment. The area is categorized by a maze of playground tubes similar to the original. Fifth, you can take a rocket in the tube area to reach the clouds. This layer is the most barren of the 6 main areas, as it only has a cloud plane and an exit. However, it is a great way to get a top-down view on the map. Lastly, the church is located a bit out of the way. It is beside the school. It seems as if the church is always closed, but it is still an imposing landmark nonetheless.

There are two unique friendly entities in level 18, the Plush Dino and the Booknado. The Plush Dino is a stuffed dinosaur. He will lead you to the rocket ship slowly, but if you pet him he will follow you instead for a short time. The Booknado is a large tornado made of books and can be found in the library.

All of level 18 is categorized by a childlike atmosphere, uncanny proportions, and a strong sense of nostalgia. A great new track by LunaNightZ is in the school. More audio is coming soon though!

[b]Added 5 new meats[/b]

Wretches, Skin-givers, Partygoers, Lighters, and Clumps now all drop meat most of the time. These meats aren't anything special, however some have some interesting effects. For example, the lighter meat has an aura emanating from it.

[b]Added a keypad to the red room in level 2[/b]

The red room radio in level 2 had a set of numbers in the audio file that didn't have any correlation to the game until now. Now there is a keypad that leads to a secret room!

[b]Added "far away entity spawners"[/b]

This is a new feature that continuously spawns entities if there are no entities on the level for some large levels. More entities will spawn if you shoot weapons frequently without a suppressor.

[b]Revamped level !-![/b]

A level !-! revamp was hinted at a couple of devlogs ago, and now it's here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/055f0a741cd06106ab0f1d39e3eca74d0f4f14db.png[/img]

Level !-! is now fully procedural, with around 22 chunks to generate. Many chunks have multiple variants too, with different furniture variations or item placements. There are 3 main types of chunks: Hotel chunks, obstacle chunks, and blue room chunks. Hotel chunks are normal chunks that build most rooms and hallways. They range from hotel halls to laundry rooms, to receptions rooms and more. Obstacle chunks have special challenges to overcome similar to level RUN's obstacles. Mazes of barrels and fences, hallway blockages, split hallways with two fates, trap rooms, and many more. Lastly, blue rooms can generate which are safe havens where entities cannot go.

[b]Added several props to level 5[/b]

This is part of an ongoing project to revamp level 5, and it will continue into next week. This week though, the rooms on the side of the main lobby and the rooms in the suites area have been revamped. Many more rooms will be redone in the next update.

Here's a before and after:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/e6d931f23082ef2e7fa79ec42f927b501c24f002.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/d18647a90d3b5720f31db8eaa82c1732645df767.png[/img]

[b]Added new audio to level 18[/b]

Several audio files such as kids playing, cafeteria noise, and classroom ambience have been added to Level 18's main map. Do note, we had thought that we had fixed the grass in level 18 not showing, however, we could not seem to fix that issue in time for the update.

[b]Added new chunks to Level Fun[/b]

A couple of new wall color variations have been added to Level Fun.

[b]Revamped level 31[/b]

Level 31 has gotten a facelift. It is much darker now and has typical arcade theming. The carpet and walls all have multicolored 90s patterns, there is now steam in the main area, and there is a new model for skates. You all voted for this level on our discord polls.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42232632/4f2ce08d82416c5fcde5750b6cb4f16c9da24863.png[/img]

[b]Improved mk3 operation[/b]

The force required to pull the bolt has been decreased, tolerances have been worked on for interaction points, and the animation has been improved to take less time.

[b]Categorized gameplay settings[/b]

Gameplay settings is now divided into three parts: the first is a technical part containing system settings and controls, the second is devoted to gameplay options, the third is for more fun settings. Suggested by @LUKA on our discord.

[b]Added MP7 SMG[/b]

A new SMG has been added, the MP7. This top-charged, 30 round SMG is a more accurate and deadly SMG than the Mac-11, while being less bulky than SMGs like the Vector. The community voted on this in a poll.

[b]Added Barrett M82[/b]

A new rifle has been added, the Barrett M82. This .50 BMG Anti-Materiel Rifle is a hefty piece of machinery. It doesn't work very well as a primary or a secondary, but is instead meant for a support weapon role. This rifle can be seen in levels 3, 4, and 11 protecting MEG bases. The community voted on this in a poll.

[b]Added mac-11 custom gun skins[/b]

The Mac-11 now has a custom gun skin system. You can apply the custom skin in the gun store. Then, to choose the texture, upload it to the internet, copy the link, create a file in a directory C:/BrVRFiles called m11.txt, and paste the link in there. Templates are in the discord server under #guides.

The starting area of level 25 has gotten a facelift, receiving updates to many rooms. There is now on average more lighting and detail. More vending machines are now present, and several of the walls have been replaced with futuristic ones from level 201.

Bounciness of the player against walls has been improved, however half-height objects still bounce just as much.

Ah yes, an orange room in level 18 with two white-out windows and a single school desk in the very middle. Sound familiar? Suggested by @LUKA on our discord.

This may seem like a strange concept, however it was one of the very first weapons to be in BrVR. It is now back. It is a chicken that you can through at clumps to kill them. There is also a timed detonation system on the chicken itself. Suggested by @Cameraman on our discord.

The revolver has a new animation when popping out the cylinder.

A pool chunk and a new hallways chunk have been added to level !-!.

Fixed the lods on the red room radio

[b]Revamped level 18[/b]

A new level 18 is now here! This level revamp may just be the largest one that we've attempted yet. This is only its second week in the game, the first being as a preview. There are still many bugs, but we feel that it is in a good enough state to ship out as a Beta.

There are two maps to level 18, the spawn map and the main map. First, I will talk about the spawn map.

The spawn map is a maze of rooms, separated into three main halls. You start in a large colorful playroom with tons of oversized toys like a xylophone and rocking horse. You can even walk on the xylophone and play it! The first hallway is cloud-themed. There are many oversized dinosaur toys inside of it, among other props. The second hallway is a dark blue kindergarten classroom. There are small rock climbing walls near the edges, and a few toys in the classroom itself. In the back halls of the classroom is a strange area with uncanny AI paintings on the walls. This leads to the main map. The third hallway is a very dark children's bedroom with many blankets and beds. There are also several desks which contain drawings with some of our playtesters' names on them. This room also leads to the main map.

The main map is a vast expanse of childlike areas. It is separated into 6 main areas: the neighborhood, the school, the playground, the tubes, the clouds, and the church. First, the neighborhood contains all sorts of suburban houses similar to those of level 9. These houses contain many bits of trash and surreal scenes like lightbulbs baking on a stovetop. It is heavily implied that kids have lived in these houses at one point or another. Second, the school is an eight-part complex of rooms. The school itself is separated into two parts, the daycare and the high school. The daycare is filled with rooms like a stuffed animal room, a room full of boxes, a locker maze, and more. The high school is filled with rooms like classrooms, cafeterias, and libraries. Third, the playground is a smaller area with a large amount of modern playground equipment. There is also a tennis enclosure there, which you can walk into. Fourth, the tubes is the section that is the most similar to the original level 18. There is a lot of playground equipment here as well, however it is all run-down Russian playground equipment instead of modern American equipment. The area is categorized by a maze of playground tubes similar to the original. Fifth, you can take a rocket in the tube area to reach the clouds. This layer is the most barren of the 6 main areas, as it only has a cloud plane and an exit. However, it is a great way to get a top-down view on the map. Lastly, the church is located a bit out of the way. It is beside the school. It seems as if the church is always closed, but it is still an imposing landmark nonetheless.

There are two unique friendly entities in level 18, the Plush Dino and the Booknado. The Plush Dino is a stuffed dinosaur. He will lead you to the rocket ship slowly, but if you pet him he will follow you instead for a short time. The Booknado is a large tornado made of books and can be found in the library.

All of level 18 is categorized by a childlike atmosphere, uncanny proportions, and a strong sense of nostalgia. A great new track by LunaNightZ is in the school. More audio is coming soon though!

Level 8 was completely rebuilt from scratch in this update! The revamp was inspired by the book Journey To The Center Of The Earth by Jules Verne. There are now all-new caves and rocks, plus a giant ocean in the middle of the areas. The graphics have been overhauled with higher-definition rocks and stalagmites. The gameplay is more vertical, allowing to go down large shafts and swim in water. Don't worry, the fights with the centipede and the large spider are still present.

[b]Added new survivor tapes[/b]

A new tape (joining the 20+ others) by @SherlockBuzti is in-game in level 22. Plus, another new tape by @cameraman from our discord is in-game in level 480. Thank you both for your contribution!

[b]New songs[/b]

There are now 2 new songs in-game. The first is in the new level 8's ocean, and the second is in level 15. Suggested by @LunaNightZ on our discord.

A 12ft tall creature is in the level 8 ocean now, he is slow and zombie-like however is quite creepy. He appears nowhere else, but he may in the future.

Now there are more props like shelves, plants, and other office-y props.

notes.title: V. 3.19 "Level 44 update"
notes.notes:
[b]Added level 44[/b]

A sprawling retail complex level. Level 44 contains two different areas, the stores and the back areas. The stores have orange walls and bare shelves with store closing signs on the ceiling. The back areas have brick walls, machinery, and some resources scattered around. There are also some rare occurances, like finding rooms that have red lights or a room that has a strange electrical noise. The only entities are skin-stealers. Level 44 uses the infinite generation algorithm.

[b]Added door pictures to levels 44, 163, 250, 370, 422[/b]

These should fill in some of the doors with no pictures in the hub. I will do more soon.

[b]Added rarely-spawning rooms to level FUN[/b]

There are two new room types you can find in level FUN. The first is a set of hallways with fences barricading the ends, blood spatter everywhere, and a metal roof. The second is a room like all of the other party rooms, except it contains supplies housed in chests.

[b]Added new year event[/b]

The new year's ball drop is BACK! Once it becomes midnight, the ball will drop and Srooc Light will fall from the sky. There will also be big "2024" text this year.

[b]Varied bullet hole decals[/b]

There are now four different bullet hole decal variants for small-caliber weapons.

[b]Fixed 870 BCG clipping[/b]

The bolt carrier group of the 870 shotgun would clip into the back of the gun. This is now fixed.

[b]Added LODs to skin-stealers[/b]

Since skin-stealers don't really need to be high-detailed at all times, LODs have been added to improve performance.

[b]Added tick delay for enemies[/b]

All enemies now have a delay for any scripts they perform every tick. This also increases performance.

[b]Added a BCG to the g28 rifle[/b]

It didn't have one, so now it does. This means you can use the bolt release that was already implemented for the M4A1

[b]Fixed some visual issues with doors[/b]

Since doors got resized in the last update, there were several visual breaks with extra doors and text attached to no-clip-a-matics. These should be fixed.

[b]Fixed greenrooms door picture[/b]

Previously, it wouldn't render. Now it does!

Happy new year everybody! 2024 will be bright as ever, and we plan to continue improving the game and adding new features in 2024.

notes.title: V. 3.18 "The small QOL update"
notes.notes:

A secret sublevel has been added to level 370! This level is merely a dark version of level 998's staircase, but turned 90 degrees on its side. Very trippy.

[b]Added a christmas tree and wreath to the frontrooms[/b]

It's the christmas season. In the last update we made partygoers wear hats, and now we bring more christmas decor. This will be the last week to access it!

[b]Removed level 4 brick spam[/b]

This was a strange feature where you could shoot a spot on level 4's wall to get bricks. This has been removed.

[b]Turned up level 7 voiceline's volume[/b]

Previously, it was very silent. This is fixed.

[b]Added haptics to many objects[/b]

Revolvers, lighters, torches, glowsticks, and other items now have haptics for interaction.

[b]Made doors slightly taller[/b]

Doors used to be around the player's standing height, now they are taller.

[b]Added a resubmit button to the questionaire[/b]

Once you submit the questionaire in the tutorial, there is now a resubmit button that you can press.

[b]Scrap gun now needs to have the ejector pulled open[/b]

The scrap gun seemed to be too simple to operate. Now, you have to pull open the ejector, increasing reload time.

[b]Improved sandbox item menu hit detection[/b]

Selecting items on the sandbox item menu is no longer as buggy.

[b]Lessened the cooldown between changing channels on the radio[/b]

Self-explanatory

notes.title: V. 3.17 "The Hidden Rooms Update"
notes.notes:
[b]Added Red Room Radios[/b]

In this new update, there are now many red rooms you can find throughout the backrooms. These always are crammed with props or rubble, and have a single radio sitting on a table. When turned on, the radio will play any number of creepy sounds depending on what level you're on. These can be found in levels 2, 3, 15, 22, 25, 33, and more.

[b]Revamped level 9.1[/b]

This fixes the specularity of the rocks, adds a ton of rubble, and adjusts fog. Pretty basic changes but it really changes the feel of the sublevel.

[b]Added back alleys to level 15[/b]

The large open spaces in level 15 have been replaced with even more cramped corridors. Even though they're far away from the spawn where most of the lights are, these spaces are still lit.

[b]OOB no-clip[/b]

If a player reaches -300,000 centimeters below the floor of the level, the level will restart. So, if you fall out of the map this will help.

[b]Added sounds to level 40 minigames[/b]

The button to start them now plays a little beep, plus the turrets in General Starflare's Entity Mowdown now play a firing noise.

[b]Added shadows to level 18[/b]

This change adds a lot of depth to the level! Also, I changed the colors up a bit, now the sky is a bit more purple.

[b]Added partygoer santa hats[/b]

It's Christmastime in the backrooms, and the partygoers are showing up with all sorts of jolly greetings such as a tooth-filled arm to the face.

[b]Fixed some z-fighting in level 36 [/b]

A small change that fixes some texture flickering with the doors to the parking garage.

notes.title: V. 3.16 "The attachment overhaul update"
notes.notes:
[b]Overhauled gun attachments[/b]

Now, one tap with the screwdriver will activate the attachment, then you can tap again to change it from a red dot to a laser to a scope. This makes attachments simpler and you don't have to worry about losing them through levels since you can just re-apply them!

[b]Added a new radio show to the portable radio[/b]

This one features Radio Ralph ranting about skin-stealers and his way to work, then capping it off with a nice musical number. The runtime is around 5 minutes. It is also available on youtube, the video is named "Radio Ralph Backrooms Radio Excerpt".

[b]Added a new area and exit to level 20[/b]

Now you can jump over the wall near the loading bay to gain access to a back area with a bunch of rooms.  The door there in the back gets you to level 21.

[b]Revamped level 23[/b]

Now the level has a ceiling made of ground with huge upside-down trees. There's also 2 new glow rooms, each are snaking complexes full of rooms and treasure. There's also a new exit that leads to level 46.

[b]Added a hand cannon[/b]

A simple craftable weapon capable of firing one very heavy round, and that's it. Once it's fired, it's fired. Carry 3-4 for best results. Suggested by Gatchi13 on our discord server.

[b]Changed some firing sounds[/b]

Shotgun firing now has a boomier sound, and the m1 garand's firing sound is also much punchier.

[b]Changed 1887 shotgun shell animation[/b]

The shells inside the gun will now correctly animate to display the state of how much ammo is inside of the gun.

[b]Fixed fatal error on level 94[/b]

You would spawn in the sky with no way to get down, this is fixed.

notes.title: V. 3.15 "The DIY Update"
notes.notes:
[b]Redid crafting[/b]

There are now over 10 different crafting materials, all able to be stored in an ammo pouch-like system. These materials now show up on the crafting table UI and crafting is simply a button press. Much more fluid and much better than the old system. Also, it is more polished in many areas.

[b]Added crafting material drops in many levels[/b]

You will now see crafting materials in many levels such as 2, 3, 9, 20, and others. Those levels I've listed are hotspots, but many crafting materials are available in other levels too.

[b]Added brass knuckles + dagger[/b]

No, they aren't two separate items. You can now craft brass knuckles that have a dagger attached already, and it is much more powerful than the standard ones.

[b]Added brick on a stick[/b]

It's literally a brick affixed to a fire axe handle. It does a good bit of damage and has a large hitbox. It even allows you to do ledge clambering, similar to the game "Getting Over it". However, it is also very heavy and unwieldy.

[b]Added scrap gun[/b]

A single shot 7.62x51 rifle made out of assorted metal and screws. It is relatively simple though, once you put the bullet in the slide automatically goes forward and once you shoot it automatically thrusts back, ejecting the round.

[b]Added scrap gun auto[/b]

A 9mm version of the gun above. It also fires from an open bolt and is very unwieldy. It is very similar to the Mac-11 SMG.

[b]Added scrap flashlight[/b]

A flashlight with very bad efficiency and a scrappy appearance. The battery wears out twice as fast compared to the normal flashlight.

[b]Added scrap crowbar[/b]

It's a plain, grey crowbar but with a knife affixed to the curved end for extra damage. Also has a very large damage hitbox compared the the normal crowbar.

[b]Added punching[/b]

Ever found yourself in a really sticky situation and you didn't bring adequate weaponry? Maybe that longsword is just out of reach? Well, now you can just punch the entity! Note that punching does very little damage and is generally only a last-ditch "defense". Suggested by Gatchi13 on discord.

[b]Fixed a weird bug with head gore[/b]

While facelings played their scream animation, it turns out that if their head exploded they would bug out instead of dying properly. This is fixed.

[b]Added sideways recoil to Mac-11[/b]

This simple changes increases the SMG's spread without being too terribly obtrusive. It also reduces the long-range potential of the weapon.

[b]Rebalanced certain stashes[/b]

Some stashes have loot added/removed from them compared to when they were first added.

[b]Added physical bolt release to m4a1[/b]

A fun feature for realism. Now, once you're done firing the bolt will lock open just like on the real gun, and you can press the bolt release to send the bolt flying forward, picking up another round. Alternatively, you can just pull the charging handle.

[b]Changed magazines for m4a1, ak47, aks74u to all have 30 rounds[/b]

Self-explanatory

[b]Made the mk3 bolt more accurate to irl[/b]

The bolt handle moves now, but the piece behind it now remains at a net 0 rotation.

[b]Made the killshack mini range longer[/b]

I've made it longer, added walls on both sides, and staggered the targets so that you can do some longer-range shots!

[b]Removed assault rifles from levels[/b]

Many AK-47's and M4A1's have been removed from levels. As we've always said, we're constantly shaping the game to lean less on piles of guns and more on bought/crafted/scavenged guns. Pro tip: if you want an AK-47, then your best bet is to go to Shadow Tactics on level 1's BNTG base.

[b]Simplified ammo pouch[/b]

Small change, the ammo pouch now counts ammo in terms of small and large ammo compared to how it was originally (it counted every magazine separately). This is really big for me, so I can add things to the ammo pouch system without excess hassle. This also effects ammo making, so you can craft small and large ammo now. This does not effect shotguns or grenade launchers, and you will continue to be able to use all of the shells you love.

[b]Blued Russian ammo correctly[/b]

Russian ammunition (7.62x25, 7.62x39, 5.45x39) was not correctly colored. This is fixed, giving the rounds a greenish hue with more orange lead.

notes.title: Hotfix
notes.notes:
This hotfix includes two things:

[b]Redo of vault changes[/b]

In the latest update, the vault was changed from infinitely spawning items to having a set quantity. We got a multitude of people from our steam community and our discord server saying that it was a bad change, so we have listened to all of you and reverted that change! I don't believe this should have any impact on your vault's save data, it should only affect the spawning/saving of items.

[b]Gun sound changes[/b]

The G28 and M4A1 rifles now both have a new charging handle grab/release noise. This noise is much more realistic as it was recorded from a very similar gun in real life!

notes.title: V. 3.14 "Frontrooms Sweet Frontrooms update"
notes.notes:
[b]Added youtube to the frontrooms TV[/b]

You can now browse youtube while sitting on your couch eating fried chicken. Two caveats: It loads quite slowly, and there isn't really a search function. But, you can still totally watch some content!

[b]Made the frontrooms computer functional[/b]

The frontrooms computer now has the same script as The End's computer does. This means the computer can turn on/off, restart, launch applications, access the start menu, etc.

[b]Items in vault cannot spawn infinitely now[/b]

A big change! Now, if you put one item in, you get one item out. This helps balence a lot of the game, as if you have an M4A1 and lose it, it's gone for good now! (Unless of course you go back to exactly where you died).

[b]Added an adapter to the frontrooms computer that allows you to read notebook notes[/b]

The notebook is a small, cramped interface for reading the notes you have gathered, so now you can press a button on the frontrooms computer to go into a note viewer. You can see all of the notes you've gathered and put into your notebook!

[b]Added Level Theta[/b]

Our first user-created level made by Gatchi13. It's an aquarium level, with many glass enclosures and many corridors. There is also a long ramp that leads from the top of the level to the very bottom. Off of that twisting and turning ramp, there are many hallways which lead into rooms like galleries, shrines, pools, and more. There's also an office room at the top and a mysterious shipping container maze near the bottom. If you adventure far enough into this level (it's huge!) you can even find a long-lost locomotive. We applaud Gatchi13 for creating this level and we hope that other user-created levels will be added in the future!

[b]Added more rubble to level 22[/b]

Self-explanatory. Level 22 was supposed to be a destroyed car park, and it is indeed now a destroyed car park.

[b]Added stashes to The Mountain Village[/b]

The Mountain Village was such a linear level, and now I've spiced it up with a good few areas outside of the main valley. Those being a stash, and a random loot area.

[b]Added more detail to levels negative 6 and negative 8[/b]

In level negative 6 there is now more cinder-block rubble and props. In level negative 8 there are now more rocks coating the walls and less rigid architecture.

notes.title: V. 3.13 "The lost treasure update"
notes.notes:
[b]Added stashes to levels[/b]

These bits of lost treasure are tucked away in unlikely places on many different levels of the backrooms! They contain a gun, an item case, and a note from whoever left the stash. These stashes can be found in a multitude of levels! They are often very hidden though.

[b]Added random loot cases full of money[/b]

These new loot crates look like yellow versions of the item crates, but they have 3000 backrooms bucks worth of cash inside of them. They randomly spawn in levels such as 2, 3, 5, and 13. Generally they spawn more in more mazelike levels.

[b]Added new money stack[/b]

This money stack feels good to hold because it's 10 100bb bills stuck together! These are found in the cases mentioned prior.

[b]You can store money with trigger now[/b]

Money can be pocketed into your wallet now by just pressing trigger in a similar way to adding ammo to your ammo pouch.

[b]Tutorialized money[/b]

Money now has a small section at the very end of the tutorial where it shows you what money looks like and how to store it.

[b]Replaced the death and damage noises[/b]

The "UUGGGGHH" noise has been replaced with lighter grunts for small damage and bigger ones for death. Suggested by Grimnee on our discord server.

[b]Added We've got Skin to Quarter Life[/b]

The fourth chapter of Fordon Greeman's adventures continues with We've got Skin. A pretty long chapter taking place in a storage facility. It is currently unfinished though, I will work on it soon.

[b]Added a bucket of chicken to backrooms burger[/b]

A bucket of KFC-style chicken, what else could you ask for? Deep fried and boiled with no artifical flavors. Suggested by Dave on our discord server.

[b]Revamped level 3[/b]

Level 3 got an absolute facelift. The layout remained the same, however all of the materials on the walls and floors changed. There is now cinder block rubble, trims, and other embellishments. It really looks decrepit now!

[b]Removed Bow + Arrow from tutorial[/b]

Simple change. It was fairly janky and we didn't want to highlight it in the tutorial.

notes.title: Version 3 of BrVR (ABSOLUTELY MASSIVE)
notes.notes:
Hello everybody! Today we release fully, and are out of early access after 1 year and 1 month. Tons of new features, bug fixes, and upgrades today! This comes after 21 major updates in the 1.0 update cycle and 68 major updates in the 2.0 update cycle. All weekly, all the time.

Before we get started, we would love you on our [url=https://discord.gg/qm2mx2cdHh]discord[/url] to help shape the game.
Secondly, if you're enjoying the game please leave a Steam review with your thoughts.
Thirdly and lastly, Happy birthday to Banana Cat, one of our playtesters.

[b]Revamped the Tutorial[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42232632/6ad5f76890cdd1a728ef36be6d06716f998560df.png[/img]

The tutorial is all-new. It takes place in the frontrooms now, and has a brutalist concrete feel. It has two ranges, and a setup menu all integrated into the tutorial. The last room has been shortened, and the room with the upgrade bench and crafting bench now uses the integrated workbench layout. There is now a new section titled "Know your entity" which shows wanderers four entities and how to defeat them. This took Paul and I ages to put together, I hope you enjoy the new upgrades here!

[b]Added level 999[/b]

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/42232632/5dba71f050ef2e3b443e4743142c331e64fa5a9c.png[/img]

A starry night sky is present with asteroids all around. It's peaceful, but it seems everybody left. There are also long-abandoned houses and taller buildings that house secrets. What were they doing there? This level also is completely greyscale. The comets fly by and you stare into the sky. How could this get more peaceful?

[b]Added Level 46[/b]

A long, windy, yet surprisingly calm desert level. This level is a giant "M" shape when you look at it from above, as you take three sharp turns to go from the start to the end. The start has a large temple and a small mountaintop ruins. It also has a large waterfall with a small rocky pond below. The ending section has an even larger sandstone temple, with extra houses where the exit door is located. There is a large oasis at the end as well, sporting tall palm trees and a large pool of water. There are also two small castle-like areas in the middle of the level that have supplies. In addition, there are many secret areas.

[b]New entity, sand demons[/b]

These beasts hide out in Level 46 and look like facelings, but with larger limbs and no face. However, the largest difference between them and facelings is that they are completely made out of sandstone. They jump to attack you, and the jumps do a bit of initial damage + bleeding damage. They can also melee attack, but this is much rarer to see.

[b]Avatars are now off by default[/b]

There is no checkbox to turn them on, you have to go to the frontrooms closet to turn them on now. You can also switch back to gloves only right there.

[b]Improved grab-pulling[/b]

Pulling an object from afar (while it still only takes up the grip button) is much more like Boneworks than the original BrVR. It interpolates the rotation (as well as the position) to the hand, is slower, and has a smaller radius to actually grab the item once it's pulled.

[b]Did accurate chambering mechanics to all weapons[/b]

Take the mag out, put it in, take it out again, put it in again, and as long as you have more than 0 ammo you won't have to pull the charging handle once. This works different for open-bolt weapons.

[b]Added 4 new songs[/b]

These are all tracks playing on the radios around the levels. These are all synth jams with a solid beat. They are all a bit different from the classical and jazz music heard in the other levels, a welcome break. This also means there are 4 new radios in these levels, but that begs the question who put them there? Hmmm.

[b]Added the supernova shotgun[/b]

A nice Benelli product now in-game! A solid 6-round pump shotgun that has a picatinny rail on top.

[b]Added more animations to entities[/b]

When you approach a faceling, he will play a new alarm animation and sound! In other words, he will scream at you! Hounds, when jumping, now have a new alarm sound too, and the chance for them to jump has increased from 20% to 33%.

[b]Added destructibles[/b]

Destructible vases, boxes, and more! Finally, players can open up the mystery "Amazon package" in level 0. Peace at last.

[b]Added stealth[/b]

Near an entity? See him in the next room over? Might just want to keep it on the down-low if you don't have any business fighting. Sprinting will now instantly alarm entities if you are near them. This isn't the same for all entities, some hear better than others. But generally speaking, sprinting 20 meters away from them is safe.

[b]Better partygoer balloon hit detection[/b]

Ever since version 1.3 and the dawn of partygoers in BrVR, you have been able to shoot their balloons. However, due to how projectile systems are built out, they all hit the balloons slightly differently. This is fixed, and you should be able to hit the balloons with anything now!

[b]Full auto balloon gun[/b]

A fun weapon for arena mode. Hold down the trigger and spray death, level fun style. Possibly outlawed in The Backrooms Geneva Convention after the FUN war in level 52, but the MEG still allows use of it.

[b]Added carrots, potatoes, and radishes[/b]

Three new fruits and vegetables! These aren't much different from the other ones in terms of nutrition though.

[b]Added new houses to level 9[/b]

Some near the second highway, and some elsewhere. There's also some new foliage and terrain variation on that level.

[b]Revamped the Charleston button in the snackrooms[/b]

Level 6.1, AKA the snackrooms, has never been this fun! Now pick from songs on a little UI, a simplified interface. This level has also been optimized considerably.

[b]Replaced sandwiches[/b]

What's better than sitting down in level 0 and having a good 'ol chicken sandwich? If you said "absolutely nothing", you'd be correct. Don't be a fool and go crazy back there, have a chicken sandwich on your person for tougher times ahead.

[b]Added the Degle .50[/b]

We are on the growing list of games that have this joke weapon. Cardboard deagle. What could be better? It does 20 damage compared to the 70 that the deagle does.

[b]Did PBR texture changes to levels 13, 15, 17, 11, 26, 40 and 3999[/b]

Level 13's wallpaper and carpet looks better. Level 15's walls look better. Level 17 actually looks like an aircraft carrier interior. Level 11 has normals and roughness in the streets. Level 26's walls look better. Level 40's carpet and walls look better. Level 3999's tiles look better.

[b]Renamed the M16 to the M4A1[/b]

Haha, it was named the M16 the entire time. We just completely missed this. Shame on us XD

[b]Fixed the Chris Vector hitbox in the casino[/b]

Try to steal Casino Chris' prized possession? Now it's a smoother experience. but remember, crime never pays especially with skin-stealers.

[b]Made Casino Chris play his own slot machine[/b]

Ever 13 seconds he reaches for a chip. Every 13 seconds he plays it. And every 13 seconds, he feels the crushing defeat come over his skin-stealer body. He lost again. Is this how it will end for Chris?

[b]Added a "skin-stealer room service" minigame[/b]

A silly little minigame, you deliver almond water to random rooms in level 13. You win 900 dollars per almond water served.

[b]Redid the bar 13 bartending minigame[/b]

Instead of an awkward, cartoony speech bubble, there's now a monitor that shows the order. Pretty simple change.

[b]Added more entity sports cards[/b]

You can buy them at the Pawn Shop in level 1 and hoard them with the "save level data" feature. In the next update, the prices will go up considerably and you will be able to sell them for money. Get in on the deals now! There are 8 different cards to collect, with more on the way. There are also "wax packs" that have 10 random cards.

[b]Added quarter life levels to the hub[/b]

Anomalous skin, Unforeseen skin, and skin complex are all available from the hub. You have to unlocked them first though, and since they're an Easter egg they aren't available in the sandbox hub.

[b]Added BUZTELLA[/b]

If you are a very certain person you may know what this means. Inside joke.

[b]Added new videos to the TV in the frontrooms[/b]

Some fun lil news broadcasts! These replace the old BrVR videos that were once on the TV

[b]Added more orange and blue crates to outposts[/b]

These give higher-value loot than the standard beige crate. They also require a crate key, and those can be found in outposts. You see where I'm going here.

[b]Added a new poster to the casino[/b]

It's for "social distancing" and it's a play on Casino Chris's animation. What a skin-stealer. Talked about him 3 times already. Stay "about this long" away from each other to stay safe from the hound virus!

[b]The batteries stick in the ammo pouch[/b]

No more scrambling for batteries when it starts to go under 25%. They are all in your ammo pouch like everything else.

[b]Added lamps that turn on/off via a button[/b]

These are just table lamps with simple buttons, nothing too special.

[b]Added machines that turn on/off with buttons[/b]

In level 15, you can turn on/off the machines with two separate interactions. These machines play pipe noises and such.

[b]Improved revolver animation[/b]

New sounds for putting in a speedloader, plus an empty speedloader now physically falls out upon it being done loading.

[b]Added a light function to the flashlight[/b]

It sort of shows "rings" around the flashlights cone of influence. This cone is slimmer, but is much longer than before. However, it is a bit duller overall (wall hack guy reference!)

[b]Added a working record player to the frontrooms and level 5[/b]

You can play disks, and the player has a moveable head. You can move it by pressing trigger while holding it. There is also a record player on level 5 with a different song. Real roaring 20's vibes.

[b]Added new molotov cocktails[/b]

It's a glass bottle now, has a fire effect, and a glass break noise. The functionality is the same.

[b]Revamped the hub[/b]

It looks a lot more like the wikidot picture! It's brighter, with more lights and lines. There are also curbs and more street markings. So much better than the old version.

[b]Optimization of many levels[/b]

Hardcore culling, lods, and texture changes has led to better framerates for all! Less stutter, less dropped frames, and more than that, more happy people (and skin-stealers) exploring the backrooms.

[b]Redid post-processing in the frontrooms apartment[/b]

The apartment looks better with better exposure settings and of course better color grading.

[b]Added more furniture to level 5[/b]

More chairs, pillars, nightstands, drawers, and more. Really livens up the place in the darker areas of the lobby!

[b]You can now upgrade the flashlight[/b]

It takes 2 batteries and a flashlight to upgrade. Once upgraded, the flashlight consumes 90 times less battery. How this is accomplished, the MEG will never know.

[b]Added an indication that slots are full[/b]

OMG! CAN'T STORE STUFF IN MY BACKPACK. GAME BROKEN.
Not anymore! Now you know when it's your fault that the slots "aren't working". You can also know when it's the game's fault (Awww c'mon!)

[b]Fixed recoil on the 870[/b]

Boomstick means boom, that boom includes some velocity backwards. So now instead of awkwardly turning, it actually pushes back. Crazy. (I was crazy once! They locked me in a room. A skin-stealer room with skin. Skin-stealer skin makes me crazy).

[b]Added removable caps to almond water[/b]

A bittersweet change, but a neat realism change. Essentially, you can pull the caps off and take 10 separate drinks now.

[b]Redid camp amber[/b]

More concrete, props, and a more grungy feel. This will continue to get more upgrades.

[b]Added a ragdoll fling multiplier[/b]

Ragdolls can fling upward with this new optional setting. This is legitimately hilarious. It only works for humanoid entities and hounds right now.

[b]Added a setting for watch presence on hands[/b]

You can have the watch be on both hands (default), right hand, or left hand. Pretty basic setting.

[b]Added a setting for door picture presence[/b]

If off, door pictures will show up and so will the back section of the no-clip-o-matic doors. If on, door frames and the clock will be the only things showing. Combine this with the doorframe replacements for a neat no-clipping experience.

[b]Revamped the cimkin rooms[/b]

Thanks cameraman. More fried chicken.

[b]Added physical props to level 71[/b]

Boxes are physical and able to be picked up. Pretty basic change.

...

That's it!!

...

A bit of a premature statement. There are tons of smaller changes I didn't mention here. However, that's all of the major changes. It's been a wild ride for us and our fam, and a really fun one.

For reference, BRVR WILL STILL UPDATE AFTER THIS UPDATE. We will continually fix things and add new content until BrVR hits "4.0". Then we'll do smaller, less frequent (mostly quality of life) changes. We started in October of 2021, and released Early access in July of 2022. But now, we have this big date and event to remember. We would like to thank our wonderful playtesters over on our discord for finding bugs and helping out immensely.

Hope you all have a fun time with this update!

notes.title: Version 2.48
notes.notes:
Hello BrVRers! Since we're gearing up for release I will start doing more detailed changelogs for each update. A ton of excellent features today!

[b]Redid level 9 to be an upgraded and optimized version of the old one.[/b]

Level 9 is back to its former glory. I've redone the old level 9, adding better sidewalks, highways, Newton's Realtor company, and a silly easter egg! In addition to this, it's optimized much better than the old one.

[b]Added more areas to level FUN[/b]

A couple of new rooms to spice level FUN up. The entity count has also increased by 3, adding to the danger of the level. The largest change is that the door to the level FUN minigames has been moved back further, meaning it isn't a straight shot there any longer.

[b]Added a "Remap Jump" option that swaps the jump and short hop button[/b]

Do you feel like you'd rather have the short hop as your primary jump and get rid of the crouch jump? Well, now that's a menu option! This can help in tense situations like Level RUN where you have to time your jumps.

[b]Gun sounds revamp[/b]

The Double barrel shotgun, gatekeeper, aks74u, and 1911 have better sounds. They make these weapons feel better to use. Not only this but there is some improved haptics for some weapons.

[b]Added a new arena mode that uses a tech tree[/b]

This is major! In this mode you start with two revolvers, upgrading your equipment each wave while increasingly varied and difficult-to-defeat hordes of entities try to stop your roll. You can buy guns, grenades, and powerups VIA a tech tree screen. Try to survive for as long as you can! Do note that this will receive updates in the future, adding even more variety and also some different music.

[b]Added the skin cube, a tasty consumable[/b]

We were installing bots to our discord server, and one of them had a customizable shop. So, I made a "skin cube" item. Then I put it in the game. This tasty consumable can be cooked on a hibachi grill or eaten raw. It also comes in tubs like Royal Rations, even tastier! Stop by the old skin-stealer's home on level 3 to get some.

[b]Revamped the Menu UI[/b]

It looks flatter now, and more streamlined. Plus, it uses a newer font! Don't worry, the functionality has been kept the same.

[b]Revamped the survival difficulty signs[/b]

The hub is one of the places that people visit most. So, I prettied up the survival difficulty signs. They now look like a TV with info instead of a glowy plaque. Also, there's a dead-zone class for some levels which are inhospitable.

[b]Skin stealers and false facelings can now have their heads dismembered if you do enough damage to their head[/b]

GORE! Of course, this is disabled if you don't have blood on. But still, if you're accurate you can explode their heads off! It does require a precise shot and some practice. Also, it doesn't do any more damage.

[b]Updated the 1911 slide to be less annoying to pull[/b]

A WIP for sure, but it's better now. I'm currently trying to port over the Deagle script to the 1911 slide, and I can't get the grab points right which results in the weirdness. Should be completely fixed soon.
 
[b]Reduced bounciness of the avatar[/b]

Less bouncy = Less janky. It still isn't completely de-bounced, but we're on our way to removing any jank with the locomotion.

[b]Improved Hound's breath[/b]

Hound's breath will now create actual fire effects upon impact with a wall or entity. This can make traveling through tight corridors tough though, as you can set fire to a hallway that you'd need to pass through. This makes hound's breath a tradeoff.

[b]Added more recoil to the M4 Shotgun, and decreased the fire rate[/b]

It was too OP, so we had to nerf it. It may seem less snappy now, but it's still a good choice for your arena mode loadout. This shotgun also feels great with hound's breath, especially so when you take into account the changes above.

[b]Added another Chaz'z Gunz N Suppliez location to level 11[/b]

Glory to CGNS, says the owner, Chaze, on our discord server. This location doesn't sell as much as the one on level 4, but it does sell torches which no other store sells.

[b]Added Holden's Anxiety relief to level 94's indoor playground[/b]

Level 94 is a relaxing level, and what could be better than getting your sanity restored with concentrated almond water, or wearing a special blue headache-reducing headband? You can buy those for backrooms bucks at Holden's Anxiety relief.

[b]Added smokestacks to level 24's factory buildings[/b]

Purple guy's plastics are producing smoke, and it needs somewhere to go. Pretty self-explanatory.

[b]Added physical asparagus to Smiley's Asparagus Shop[/b]

More produce to liven your day up! Although where the asparagus comes from is unknown, it is speculated to be grown by Grimnee's Electronics and Tech in the frontrooms. It is rumored that half comes from farms in the baltic, whereas half comes from the beautiful African Sahel. Just a theory, an asparatheory.

[b]Improved the Short Hop[/b]

It's now one impulse applied instead of two, so it feels more fluid. Also, it's less overpowered as using an energy drink won't give you as much of an advantage while using a short hop.

[b]Improved lighting on level 5[/b]

Just some slight touchups and adjustments, nothing major. It may look a bit better in some areas. Some color adjustments as well

[b]Moved the VHS filter to the graphics settings[/b]

Pretty self-explanatory, why it was in gameplay this whole time I'm not sure. The highlight color is now Yellow instead of Red

[b]Fixed some hand-hold issues with the BAR[/b]

It won't pull the charging handle immediately after you put in the mag! This makes reloading with the BAR much more fluid. Now only if I had a bipod that did something...

AND MANY SMALL CHANGES

What's to come? You can check that out here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1yVW6j8u5Ws4UVWdEbNKovr_JMEm9M8J3MmiOKmpoav4/edit
We also take suggestions on our discord here: https://discord.gg/qm2mx2cdHh
Over there we like to have FUN =), you can even get a shop in-game like the ones mentioned today (no real money)
Alright, see you guys in a few days! Bye.
